messages:
maria: Quick sanity check — ran 72h pilot for 'halley-13b' quant variants (int6 vs int8) on chat routing. Need a 1‑paragraph rec for GTN by EOD.

Talia: Thx — attached mini-results below. No huge regressions but some prompt families show accuracy slippage.

Sam: can you paste the short metric snapshot?

Talia: sure

```
sample: 10k queries (prod-like distribution)
int8: cost = $0.48 / 1k tokens | p50=62ms | p95=180ms | quality_score=0.898
int6: cost = $0.33 / 1k tokens | p50=68ms | p95=210ms | quality_score=0.912
delta_quality (int6 vs int8) = +1.4% absolute on labeled QA set
fallback mismatch rate = 2.6% (requests needing int6 for quality)
```

Talia: +1.4% quality is small but consistent in Q/A and math prompts. int8 shows lower latency/cost but a 2.6% subset where hallucination/error increases.

Ryan: what's the unit-econ impact at scale (5M tokens/day)?

Sam: quick calc —
```
5M tokens/day -> 5000 units (per 1k)
int8 cost/day ~ 5000 * $0.48 = $2400
int6 cost/day ~ 5000 * $0.33 = $1650
savings switching to int8 ~ $750/day -> ~$22.5k/month
But quality regressions affect ~2.6% traffic -> model-miss cost (supports, refunds) unknown.
```

Maria: GTN wants an action: recommend default for new product tier. My thought: default route to int8 for 80% traffic, sticky routing to int6 for identified prompt families + automatic fallback. Keep canary at 5% to monitor.

Talia: operationally feasible. We can build a small heuristic: route to int6 if prompt contains math keywords or numbers > 3 tokens, or short Q/A pattern. + KV-prefix caching to reduce cost.

Sam: propose rollout plan:
- day0: 5% canary int8 vs int6 (A/B) with human eval hooks
- day3: expand to 40% if no regression >1% on quality_score
- day7: 80% default if stable, with auto-fallback to int6 on confidence<threshold
- monitor p95 latency, cost per 1k, and "interesting-fail" rate

Maria: suggested GTN blurb (one-liner): "Recommend default int8 for cost-sensitive tiers with an 80/20 hybrid routing to int6 for risky prompt classes; canary rollout and automatic fallback to preserve quality."

Ryan: +1. Also add "expected monthly savings approx $22k at 5M tokens/day; monitor regression signal and support metrics."

devex-bot: deploy-canary created -> pipeline/halley-13b/int8-canary @1777771300

Talia: I'll prep evalset of 2k focused prompt families for the canary and a quick human review rubric.

Maria: perfect. I'll send GTN the rec + the short cost table. tagging @product-leads :eyes:

Sam: small note — include rollback rule: if human-eval delta >1.5% or support rate increases by >10% in 24h -> immediate rollback :warning:

Maria: agreed. closing — will DM draft to GTN in 30m. :thumbsup:
